questions.question: Use the check-supplier-invoice skill: can Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 be paid as it stands?

answer.text:
Chantier Moreau — **No, Zava Matériaux invoice FA-2026-0217 should not be paid as it stands**: it bills 10 pallets of ZM-20450 concrete blocks, while delivery note BL-2026-0391 records “reçu 8 pal.” and “2 palettes manquantes,” so **158,40 € HT** is in dispute, i.e. **31,68 € VAT** and **190,08 € TTC** at the invoice’s 20 % VAT rate.[1][2]  

As of the site meeting minutes no. 3 of 24/03/2026, the invoice was specifically to be checked against the 13/03/2026 delivery note before payment by 31/03/2026.[4]  

| Line | Billed | Received / ordered check | Difference | Amount at stake HT |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ZM-20450 — blocs béton creux | 10 palettes at 79,20 € HT = 792,00 € HT.[1] | Delivery note printed 10 palettes, but handwritten receipt/reserve says 8 received and 2 missing; the delivery-note evidence is OCR, but the relevant OCR confidence shown is 0.99.[2] | 2 palettes overbilled.[1][2] | 2 × 79,20 € = **158,40 € HT**.[1][2] |
| ZM-31020 — mortier | 30 sacs at 7,90 € HT = 237,00 € HT.[1] | Delivery note lists 30 sacs.[2] | No difference found.[1][2] | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| ZM-44108 — acier HA 10 | 24 barres at 9,45 € HT = 226,80 € HT.[1] | Delivery note lists 24 barres.[2] | No difference found.[1][2] | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| ZM-27340 — linteau béton | 1 unit at 164,00 € HT = 164,00 € HT.[1] | Delivery note lists 1 unit.[2] | No difference found.[1][2] | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| Livraison camion-grue | 1 forfait at 65,00 € HT.[1] | The delivery note identifies the vehicle as “camion-grue.”[2] | No difference found on the delivery service itself.[1][2] | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |

The invoice totals are 1 484,80 € HT, TVA 20 % of 296,96 €, and 1 781,76 € TTC.[1]  

The purchase tracking row for BC-2026-012 also records 1 484.8 HT ordered and 1 484.8 HT invoiced for “Blocs béton, mortier, aciers et linteau (murs),” delivered on 13/03/2026 with invoice FA-2026-0217, so it matches the invoice amount but does not clear the delivery reserve for the two missing pallets.[3][2]  

The supplier should therefore issue a credit note or corrected invoice for **158,40 € HT / 31,68 € TVA / 190,08 € TTC**, or prove/remedy delivery of the two missing pallets before payment of the full invoice.[1][2]  

If paying only the undisputed balance, the arithmetic from the cited invoice totals is **1 484,80 € HT − 158,40 € HT = 1 326,40 € HT**, **296,96 € TVA − 31,68 € TVA = 265,28 € TVA**, and **1 781,76 € TTC − 190,08 € TTC = 1 591,68 € TTC**.[1][2]

answer.text:
Meeting brief for **Chantier Moreau**, site meeting no. 4 on **07/04/2026 at 08:30 on site**, as of the latest current source I checked: **site meeting minutes no. 3 of 24/03/2026** [1].

## 1) Progress and programme to review first

- **Late / blocked by later decision — exterior joinery:** the current schedule revision A still shows delivery on 30/03/2026 and installation from 31/03/2026 to 02/04/2026 at 0%, but minutes no. 3 record VanArsdel’s postponement of delivery to 20/04/2026 and installation from 21/04/2026 to 23/04/2026; by the wiki’s stated rule, minutes no. 3 prevail over the older schedule because they have higher authority and are more recent [2][3].  
- **Due before meeting — charpente/couverture/fenêtre de toit:** the current schedule revision A planned “Charpente, couverture et fenêtre de toit” from 30/03/2026 to 03/04/2026 at 0%, and minutes no. 3 say roofing starts from 30/03/2026 with the avenant n°1 roof window installed with the roofing, so ask for status at the meeting because no later completion evidence was found [2][4].  
- **Completed before the last meeting:** the slab was complete and poured on 12/03/2026, and wall elevation was at 70% in minutes no. 3 [5][6].  
- **Starting on meeting date — electricity:** the schedule revision A shows “Électricité 1er œuvre” from 07/04/2026 to 10/04/2026 at 0%, and minutes no. 3 specify extension conduit routing from 07/04/2026 to 10/04/2026 [2][7].  
- **Resequenced — kitchen strip-out and plumbing:** the schedule revision A still shows “Cuisine : dépose et plomberie” from 27/04/2026 to 30/04/2026 at 0%, but decision D2 in minutes no. 3 advances it to 07/04/2026–10/04/2026 with the clients’ agreement; minutes no. 3 prevail by authority/recency [2][8].  
- **Resequenced — opening in existing wall:** the schedule revision A still shows the baie de liaison opening from 07/04/2026 to 09/04/2026 at 0%, but decision D3 postpones it to 27/04/2026–29/04/2026 after joinery installation; minutes no. 3 prevail by authority/recency [2][9].  
- **Next downstream milestone:** decision D1 sets temporary timber-panel closure of openings on 07/04/2026 so that extension insulation can start from 13/04/2026 [10].

answer.text:

questions.question: For the school of Montferrine, which DPGF is current, and what changed between indice A and indice B?

answer.text:
For the **école-montferrine** chantier, the current DPGF is **DEV-2026-031 indice B dated 13/03/2026**; indice B states that it “annule et remplace” the DPGF **indice A dated 13/02/2026**. [1]

As of **DPGF indice B dated 13/03/2026**, the changes from indice A to indice B are: [1][2]

| Item | Indice A | Indice B | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Post 2 — removal of existing joinery | 14 units, €2,520 HT | 16 units, €2,880 HT | Adds 2 library windows. [1][2] |
| Post 3 — aluminium double-glazed windows | 14 units, marks E1–E14, €22,960 HT | 16 units, marks E1–E16, €26,240 HT | Adds 2 library windows. [1][2] |
| Post 4 — ceiling insulation / plasterboard ceiling | €54.00/m², €19,440 HT | €51.50/m², €18,540 HT | Unit price reduced. [1][2] |
| Post 6 — sanitary block renovation | €16,400 HT | €15,900 HT | Amount reduced by €500 HT. [1][2] |
| Total HT | €85,200 | €87,440 | Overall increase stated as **+€2,240 HT**. [1][2] |
| TVA 20% | €17,040 | €17,488 | Follows the revised HT total. [1][2] |
| Total TTC | €102,240 | €104,928 | Overall increase stated as **+€2,688 TTC**. [1][2] |

The indice B observation explains the reason: a consistency change requested by the commune at the negotiation meeting of **06/03/2026**, adding the two library windows to posts 2 and 3, reducing post 4 from €54.00 to €51.50 HT, and reducing post 6 from €16,400 to €15,900 HT. [1]

questions.question: Pour l'école de Montferrine, quelle DPGF est en vigueur, et qu'est-ce qui a changé entre l'indice A et l'indice B ?

answer.text:
Au 13/03/2026, pour le chantier école de Montferrine, la DPGF en vigueur pour le marché « Rénovation énergétique de l'école élémentaire du Bourg » est la **DPGF DEV-2026-031 indice B du 13/03/2026** ; elle « annule et remplace » la DPGF DEV-2026-031 indice A du 13/02/2026.[1][2][3]

Ce qui a changé entre l’indice A et l’indice B est une modification de consistance demandée par la commune lors de la réunion de négociation du 06/03/2026 : ajout des deux fenêtres de la bibliothèque, donc les postes 2 et 3 passent à 16 fenêtres au lieu de 14.[4] Le prix unitaire HT de l’isolation des plafonds au poste 4 est ramené de 54,00 € à 51,50 €.[4] Le poste 6 est ramené de 16 400,00 € HT à 15 900,00 € HT.[4] L’écart global par rapport à l’indice A est de **+2 240,00 € HT**, soit **+2 688,00 € TTC**.[5]
